label: copy-phase input k about to output c ("k->c" bigram)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and almost only when the fed-back input is k (97% of activation mass; the rest is mostly input c). It is effectively silent for recall_idx < 3, so the k must be original token 3 or later. The strongest activations (top quartile, up to max) come when the token output after that k is c, i.e. the original sequence has the bigram k c. Under that predicate precision is 0.91, but it covers only about 56% of the mass. Weaker activations (mostly below 0.25 of max) also fire on copy-phase k followed by other tokens (v, a, j, o, w, digits), especially when a c comes soon after. Most copy-phase k inputs (about 91%) do not fire at all, so the broad predicate copy-phase k with recall_idx>=3 has mass recall 0.97 but precision 0.09. Never fires in the original or delimiter phase, or on the first occurrence of a token.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=k (+8.08), phase=2 & in_tok=c (+4.24), in_tok=k (+3.80), phase=2 & out_tok=c (+3.69), out_tok=c (+3.28), next_out=c (+3.23).
